description: This file defines structures, macros, and function prototypes related to multipart document handling and web configuration in a middleware component for a Raspberry Pi 4 environment.

classes.name: multipartdocs_t
classes.description: Structure representing a multipart document with metadata such as etag, namespace, data, size, and a link to the next document.

methods.name: readFromFile
methods.description: Reads data from a specified file into memory.

methods.name: parseMultipartDocument
methods.description: Parses multipart document data with content type and transaction UUID.

methods.name: print_tmp_doc_list
methods.description: Prints the list of temporary multipart documents.

methods.name: loadInitURLFromFile
methods.description: Loads initial URL configuration from a file.

methods.name: get_global_root
methods.description: Retrieves the global root version or identifier.

methods.name: checkRootUpdate
methods.description: Checks if the root needs an update.

methods.name: checkRootDelete
methods.description: Checks if the root has been deleted.

methods.name: updateRootVersionToDB
methods.description: Updates the root version in the database.

methods.name: get_global_transID
methods.description: Gets the current global transaction ID.

methods.name: get_global_mp
methods.description: Retrieves the global multipart document list.

methods.name: set_global_mp
methods.description: Sets the global multipart document list.

methods.name: getRootDocVersionFromDBCache
methods.description: Retrieves root document version info from cache.

methods.name: line_parser
methods.description: Parses a line of data into namespace, etag, data, and size.

methods.name: setForceSyncTransID
methods.description: Sets the forced synchronization transaction ID.

methods.name: getForceSyncTransID
methods.description: Gets the forced synchronization transaction ID.

methods.name: get_multipartdoc_count
methods.description: Returns the count of multipart documents.

methods.name: deleteFromMpList
methods.description: Deletes a document from multipart list.

methods.name: addToMpList
methods.description: Adds a document to multipart list.

methods.name: replaceMacWord
methods.description: Replaces MAC address word in string.
